page.title: Host dashboard
page.intro: Track bookings and guest messages; create and edit listings, add rooms, update the calendar in bulk, manage photos, deposits and promotions, and review party-risk warnings.

messagesPage.title: Guest conversation
messagesPage.intro: Message the guest for this booking. If there was damage after the stay, you can open a claim below to have it covered from the deposit.

dashboard.revenueLink: Revenue dashboard: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and price suggestions
dashboard.noProperties: You do not have any listings yet. Once you create your first listing you can edit it, add rooms and manage its calendar here.
dashboard.revenueHint: Revenue dashboard: occupancy, average daily rate (ADR), revenue per available room (RevPAR) and price suggestions.
dashboard.openClaimLink: Open a damage claim: choose the booking

fields.title: Title
fields.licenseHint: Province plate code + sequence number, e.g. 34-12345. Listings without a licence cannot go live.

property.manage: Manage listing: details, rooms, calendar, photos

visibility.pending: Marked as live, but not visible in search until the licence is verified.
visibility.rejected: Licence not found in the registry; the listing is not visible in search. Correct the licence number and press Save.
visibility.off: Not visible in search; guests cannot find this listing.

property.noChanges: Nothing has changed, so there is nothing to save.
property.licenseChangeNote: A new licence number is re-verified when you save; the listing will not appear in search until it is verified.
property.unpublishedNow: The listing has been unpublished and no longer appears in search.

unpublishConfirm.title: Unpublish “{title}”?
unpublishConfirm.body: The listing will no longer appear in search, so new guests cannot find it. You can make it live again at any time with the “Publish” button.

rooms.title: Rooms

add.name: Room name
add.priceModifierHint: Nightly amount added to the base price, e.g. 250 or 250.50

rooms.empty: No rooms yet. Add a room below to manage the calendar and prices.

calendar.rangeHint: {count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} selected.

calendar.noRooms: The calendar and nightly prices are managed per room. Add a room using the form above first.
calendar.priceLabel: Nightly price ({currency}) — leave empty to keep it unchanged
calendar.summary: To apply: {room}, {from} – {to} ({count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}}) — {changes}.
calendar.closeConfirmPrice: The nightly price will also be set to {price}.

bulkConfirm.title: Update many nights in the calendar?

duplicate.SAME_PROPERTY: This photo already seems to be in this listing.
duplicate.OWN_LISTING: This photo is already used in one of your other listings.
duplicate.OTHER_LISTING: A similar photo exists in another listing; please only use photos you own.

removeConfirm.title: Remove this photo?
removeConfirm.body: The photo will be permanently deleted from the listing and guests will no longer see it.

photos.tooLarge: "{name}" was not uploaded: the file is larger than the {size} MB limit.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.intro: Discounts appear as separate lines in the quote. On conflict the higher priority wins, then the larger discount; promotions marked stackable apply together.
promotions.caption: Promotion list
promotions.deactivated: Promotion was used, so it was paused instead of deleted.

form.name: Name
form.priorityHint: If several promotions match a booking, the higher priority applies first; on a tie the larger discount wins. Example: with 10% off set to “High” and 15% off set to “Normal”, the guest gets 10%.
form.stackable: Can be combined with other promotions
form.preview: Example: a nightly price of {before} becomes {after} with {percent}% off.
form.highWarning: Careful: {percent}% off is very high. Check the rate before saving.
form.highConfirmBody: Guests will pay only a small part of the price. A 100% discount makes the stay free.
form.stackableWarning: Stackable promotions apply together, so the total discount can be higher than this rate alone.
form.amountHint: In {currency}. Deducted from the stay total and never more than the total.
form.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount greater than 0.
form.fixedNeedsListing: Your listings use different currencies. Choose a single listing as the scope for a fixed amount.
form.startHint: Leave empty to start right away.
form.endHint: Valid through this day. Leave empty for no end date.
form.endBeforeStart: The end date can't be before the start date.
form.fixFields: The promotion couldn't be saved. Fix the marked fields and try again.
form.couponTaken: This coupon code is already in use. Enter a different code.
form.usageLimitHint: At least {count} (the number of times it has been used).
form.nameFieldHint: Guests see the discount under this name in their quote. {min}–{max} characters.
form.advancedSummary: (Priority: {priority}; {stackable, select, true {can be combined with other promotions} other {not combined}})
form.stackableHint: If unchecked, this promotion never applies together with others; only one is chosen. Example: a 10% early bird and a 5% mobile rate that are both stackable apply together.

promotions.cannotDelete: “{name}” has been used, so it can't be deleted. It is already paused.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete “{name}”?
deleteConfirm.body: The promotion will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
deleteConfirm.usedBody: This promotion has been used {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}, so it can't be deleted. If you confirm, it will be paused and won't apply to new bookings; you can activate it again at any time.

typeHelp.EARLY_BIRD: Applies to bookings made at least the number of days you set before arrival.
typeHelp.LAST_MINUTE: Applies to bookings made no more than the number of days you set before arrival.
typeHelp.LONG_STAY: Applies to stays of at least the number of nights you set.
typeHelp.MOBILE_RATE: Applies only to bookings made from a phone or tablet.
typeHelp.COUPON: Applies only when the guest enters the coupon code while booking. You share the code with your guests.

form.fieldErrorsSummary: {count, plural, one {# field has} other {# fields have}} a problem; fix the marked fields and try again.

create.title: New listing
create.intro: Enter the basics and your first room. You can add photos, more rooms and the calendar after the listing is created. The listing appears in search once its licence is verified.
create.descriptionHint: At least 10 characters. This is the first text guests read.
create.kycRequired: You need to verify your identity before you can create a listing. This is required for guest safety.
create.kycLink: Verify my identity on the My account page

leaveConfirm.title: Discard unsaved changes?
leaveConfirm.body: You have changes on this page that are not saved. They will be lost if you leave.
